authorityRule: Only repository-relative canonical source paths may satisfy a mandatory oracle.
provenanceRule: Every oracle declares its authority class, source path, provenance and consumer coverage items.
freshnessRule: Mandatory byte-pinned sources are stale when their recomputed SHA-256 differs from the pinned hash.
failureRule: Missing, unreadable, malformed or stale mandatory sources block the verdict.
fallbackRule: No fallback is permitted for a mandatory oracle; generated material can never replace a canonical source.
contradictionRule: Duplicate IDs, duplicate source paths with divergent pins, conflicting authorities and orphan references block the verdict.
coverageRule: mandatoryCoverage is satisfied divided by applicable mandatory items; the denominator is fixed by this registry and cannot be reduced by runtime findings.
